name: Action Bar Log
description: Keeps a short scrollback of action bar messages.

name: Anti Coords Leak
description: Hides every coordinate on screen (chat, F3, HUD, waypoints, Litematica, any mod) while you share your screen or record

name: Anti Deepslate
description: Draws deepslate, stone types, gravel, ores and bedrock as one plain block (netherite by default) so their rotation and patterns can't reveal

name: Anti Farm Lag
description: Lightens rendering near big redstone farms (observers, pistons, hoppers, TNT) without stopping them.

name: Armor & Durability
description: Shows each equipped armor piece's durability, inventory-style.

name: Armor Bar
description: Recolor the armor points above your hearts or draw your own armor icon.

name: Arrow Counter
description: Shows how many arrows you have left.

name: Attack Indicator
description: Shows the attack charge bar under your custom crosshair, styled and colored the way you like.

name: Auras
description: Show or hide auras - yours and other players' - and calm down other players' particles in busy fights.

name: Auto GG
description: Sends "gg" in chat when a minigame ends (Hypixel, Bed Wars, SkyWars, Duels...).

name: Auto Reconnect
description: Automatically reconnects after an unexpected disconnect, waiting progressively longer between

name: Background Queue Session
description: Keep a server connected in the background so you hold your spot (e.g. in a queue) while you play

name: Better F3
description: A cleaner F3 screen: compact see-through panels, Nether/Overworld coordinates for portals,

name: Block Outline
description: Replaces the default selected-block outline with a customizable color and line width.

name: Block/Entity Inspector
description: Shows extended info (registry id, NBT, UUID) for the block or entity you're looking at.

name: Boss Bar
description: Move, scale or hide boss bars - in the HUD editor you get an example bar when no boss is around.

name: C2ME (Experimental)
description: Faster world generation and loading in singleplayer on every CPU core. Applies on your next start from the Velo launcher.

name: Centered Inventory
description: Keeps your inventory in the middle of the screen when the recipe book opens.

name: Chat
description: Stacks repeated messages as (5x), timestamps, highlights your name, hides spam words, longer history.

name: Chunk Boundary Overlay
description: Renders chunk and chunk-section borders around you, for build/world-gen testing, with

name: Chunk Load Profiler
description: Highlights how long each chunk took to load relative to others (green = normal, red =

name: Client Log Viewer
description: In-game log viewer with a text filter and one-click session export.

name: Clips
description: Save the last 30 seconds of gameplay with one key (F8). Velo+ Clips Pro: 2-5 minutes at 1080p60, auto clips and share links.

name: Clock
description: Displays the current real-world time.

name: Color Grading
description: Post effects on the picture: saturation, vibrance, contrast, brightness, warmth, vignette and sharpening.

name: Combo Counter
description: Counts the hits you land in a row without getting hit back.

name: Command Keybinds
description: Bind a key to instantly run a chat command, like /spawn.

name: Container Animations
description: Containers pop, slide or zoom in when opened and ease out when closed, and items fly to where they land - shift-clicks, hotbar keys and Mouse Tweaks too.

name: Cooldowns
description: Circular cooldown timers for ender pearls, wind charges, shields and every other item cooldown.

name: Coordinates
description: Displays your current X/Y/Z position.

name: Copy Coordinates
description: Copies your current X/Y/Z to the clipboard with one keypress.

name: Cosmetic Cloaks
description: Equip a cloth-physics cloak from your local library. Purely client-rendered.

name: Custom Crosshair
description: Replaces the vanilla crosshair with one from your library - draw your own or import a PNG.

name: Damage Numbers
description: Shows the damage players take (and heal) above their heads for a moment after each hit.

name: Direction
description: A compass strip showing which way you're facing.

name: Emoji Chat
description: Shows emoji as colour pictures in chat, turns :shortcodes: into emoji when you send them and suggests emoji as you type - Tab completes.

name: Emotes
description: Emote wheel: hold B, point at an emote and let go (or press 1-8) - with effects, props, sounds and music. Get emotes in the Store.

name: Enemy Effects
description: Shows other players' potion effects and roughly how long they last above their heads.

name: Enemy Hunger
description: Estimates other players' hunger and saturation and shows it above their heads.

name: Entity Count Overlay
description: Shows loaded entity counts by type, for diagnosing entity lag on your own server.

name: Entity Detail Distance (Experimental)
description: Far-away mobs and players skip armor, held items and other extra layers - big FPS gains in crowded areas.

name: Fast Grow
description: Singleplayer: crops, amethyst, saplings and other growing blocks grow up to 100x faster.

name: Fight Recap
description: After a fight: hits, combo, reach and damage both ways, a hit timeline - and an automatic clip.

name: Fly Speed
description: Fly faster in creative, spectator and singleplayer (up to 10x).

name: FOV
description: Your field of view plus separate sliders for movement FOV kick, nausea distortion and damage tilt.

name: FPS Counter
description: Shows current frames per second.

name: Frame Time Graph
description: Rolling graph of per-frame render time in milliseconds.

name: Free Look
description: Hold the free look key to orbit the camera freely around your player in third person, without

name: Friends
description: Friends list, messages and popups. Press O to open it; see where friends are playing.

name: Full Bright
description: Makes everything lit at all read as fully bright (vanilla Night Vision rendering, always on).

name: Game Mode Presets
description: Loads a different Velo profile per game mode (Bed Wars, duels, SkyWars...) and switches back after.

name: GPU Utilization
description: Shows current GPU utilization percentage.

name: Health Indicator
description: Shows other players' hearts above their heads when they're not at full health.

name: Hearts
description: Recolor your hearts or use your own heart icon.

name: Height Limit
description: Blocks left until the build height limit and the void - for Bed Wars and SkyWars.

name: Held Item
description: Shows the icon and count of the item in your main hand.

name: Hide Foliage
description: Hides grass, ferns, dry grass, bushes, seagrass, nether sprouts and roots, leaf litter and more - clearer views and fewer polygons.

name: Hit Color
description: Pick the hurt flash color and strength for players, mobs and yourself - and tint armor and trims too.

name: Hit Particles
description: Extra particles when your hits land - a separate look for normal hits and crits.

name: Hit Sounds
description: Plays a sound only you hear when your hits land - another one for crits.

name: Hitbox Visualizer
description: Renders entity hitbox outlines for build/plugin testing, with a customizable color and line width.

name: Hold Up Items
description: Holds your item arm (or both arms) straight out in front, zombie-style, in third person.

name: Hopper Speed
description: Singleplayer: items per hopper transfer (1-64), transfer cooldown, or no hopper transfers at all.

name: Hotbar Colors
description: Color your hotbar's slots and the outline of the selected slot.

name: HUD Style
description: One font, background and accent colour for every HUD element - Inter, Sora, Space Grotesk, Poppins and more,

name: Hunger & Saturation
description: Outlines your food icons by how much saturation you have left, and lets you recolor or replace the food icon.

name: Input Latency Sub-Tick Sampling
description: Timestamps mouse clicks off the main thread so latency doesn't depend on frame rate, and (optionally) polls input again at the start of every tick to notice clicks sooner during FPS stalls.

name: Item Position
description: Move, rotate and resize your held items and hand in first person - for all items or per item type.

name: Keybind Conflict Checker
description: Lists keybinds that are bound to the same key as another binding.

name: Keystrokes
description: Shows WASD, sneak, jump and sprint key state.

name: Kill Effects
description: Plays a purely client-side visual effect (with optional sound) when a nearby entity dies -

name: Light Level Overlay
description: Shows block light levels on nearby surface blocks, highlighting where hostile mobs can spawn.

name: Low Fire
description: Lowers the fire overlay while you burn and shrinks the flames on burning players and mobs - or hides it with Fire Resistance.

name: Low Health Warning
description: Red glow around the screen (and a heartbeat) when your health is low.

name: Memory & GC Monitor
description: Shows JVM heap usage and allocation rate.

name: Minimap
description: A rotating top-down minimap of nearby terrain, sampled from vanilla's own map colors.

name: Module Profiler
description: Shows live processing time (avg/peak ms) per module, broken down by tick/world-render/HUD-render, to track down performance regressions.

name: Mouse Buttons
description: Shows mouse button state (left, right and middle in the Mouse style) with live CPS - as boxes, text or a mouse.

name: Nick Hider
description: Hides other players' nametags above their heads by scrambling them into obfuscated gibberish.

name: No Break Particles
description: Removes the particles when a block breaks and while you mine it - cleaner view, sounds stay.

name: Old Animations
description: 1.7 / 1.8 animations: no cooldown hand drop, sword blocking, block-hitting, old rod and more.

name: Packet Traffic Monitor
description: Shows inbound/outbound packet counts by type, for diagnosing plugin packet spam.

name: Particle Debug Overlay
description: Shows active particle count and type breakdown.

name: Particle Limiter
description: Caps particle density to MINIMAL to reduce lag from particle-heavy areas.

name: Particle Size
description: Makes particles smaller (less clutter in fights) or bigger.

name: Party
description: Party chat (/party), pings (V), invites and shared waypoints - parties live in the Friends menu.

name: Performance Boost
description: Presets and individually-tunable settings for maximum FPS - view distance, entities, particles, VSync, HUD caching and more.

name: Phantom
description: Singleplayer: don't trigger pressure plates, tripwires or sculk, and fly through walls in creative.

name: Ping Display
description: Shows your connection latency to the server.

name: Player Levels
description: Ranks the players in your game by the stars / level / ELO shown in the tab list.

name: PolyBlur
description: Motion blur that responds to how fast you're turning or moving - not a constant filter.

name: Pot Counter
description: Shows how many healing splash potions you have left.

name: Potion Effect Timers
description: Shows active potion effects with icon and remaining duration.

name: Reach Display
description: A red circle on the ground showing exactly how far you can hit - green when someone is in reach.

name: Render Culling
description: Stops drawing far-away armor stands, item frames, dropped items, XP, signs and chests - big FPS win in busy lobbies.

name: Resource/Shader Reload Hotkeys
description: Hotkeys to reload resource packs and (if Iris is installed) shaders without restarting.

name: Scoreboard
description: Repositions, scales, or hides the server's scoreboard sidebar - appears here automatically whenever a server actually sets one.

name: Screen Stretch
description: Stretched resolution: draw the world as 4:3, 5:4, 16:10 or your own shape and stretch it across your monitor -

name: Seamless Resource Reload
description: Reloading resource packs no longer shows the red Mojang screen - you keep playing while it loads.

name: Server Overlays
description: Bed Wars teams & generator timers, final kills, event timers, win streak - adapts to the server and game.

name: Session Auto-Fixer
description: When a server kicks you for an invalid/expired session, refreshes your saved Velo account

name: Session Stats
description: Tracks deaths and time played this session, locally only.

name: Shader Cache
description: Saves compiled shaders and Vulkan pipelines to disk, so startup and resource-pack reloads skip recompiling them.

name: Shulker Preview
description: Hold Shift over a shulker box or bundle to see what's inside. Ctrl+Shift opens it next to your inventory so you can

name: Simulation Distance
description: Shows the chunks the server simulates around you (crops, redstone, mob spawning)

name: Small Caps
description: Renders chat, action bar and Velo's own HUD text in small capitals instead of normal case,

name: Spawn Radius
description: Spheres around you showing where mobs can spawn and despawn (24 / 32 / 128 blocks),

name: Speed
description: Shows how fast you're moving in blocks per second.

name: Target HUD
description: Shows the player you're fighting: health, armor, distance and who's winning.

name: Time, Weather & Fog
description: Locks the local time-of-day and weather to a fixed state, and lets you customize or fully

name: TNT Timer
description: Shows a live countdown above primed TNT, with a customizable color and text size.

name: Toggle Sneak
description: Press sneak once to toggle it on/off instead of holding it.

name: Toggle Sprint
description: Press sprint once to toggle it on/off instead of holding it.

name: Totem Counter
description: Shows how many Totems of Undying you carry, with the totem icon.

name: Totem Pop Counter
description: How many totems your opponent popped this life - or how many you popped and have left. Resets on death.

name: TPS & Tick Graph
description: Shows server tick time (singleplayer/LAN) or connection packet rate as a proxy on remote servers.

name: Velo Loading Screen
description: A clean Velo loading screen at startup instead of the red Mojang one.

name: Velo Network
description: See other online Velo Client users' badge and cloak, and share yours (including your own custom cloak) with them.

name: Velo Shaders
description: Beta: custom Vulkan shaders, still in development. Shaders that run on Vulkan, fully customizable: presets, waving water with reflections, warm light, nicer fog, a custom sky with sun, moon, stars and aurora, bloom and colour grading - at a fraction of the usual shader cost.

name: Waypoints
description: Per-world waypoints with beams, on-screen distance markers and minimap dots. P opens the menu, N adds one where you stand.

name: Wings
description: Show or hide 3D wings - yours and other players' - and whether they flap as you move.

name: World Border Visualizer
description: Highlights the world border boundary in 3D, using the server-enforced bounds.

name: XP & Locator Bar
description: Color the experience bar, the locator bar and the XP level number.

name: Zoom
description: Hold the zoom key to smoothly narrow your FOV, spyglass-style. Scroll while held to adjust.
